# Matthew Whittle

> Data scientist and analytics lead with a background in ecology. Personal portfolio and field notebook at https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/

This site shares projects, notes and a CV. Career opportunities and collaboration are welcome outcomes; the copy is not organised around job-seeking.

## Identity

- Name: Matthew Whittle
- Location: West Yorkshire, UK
- Role (from site copy): data scientist and analytics lead; currently leads a team at SLR Consulting across data engineering, reporting and data science
- Background: ecology, then software, data, machine learning and geospatial work

## Site pages

- [Home](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/): About, featured projects and contact
- [Projects](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/work/): Index of published project write-ups
- [tilearray](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/work/tilearray/): Python library for fetching and assembling raster data from online mapping services (WMS, WMTS, WCS, XYZ) into xarray
- [Modelling bat habitat suitability across Yorkshire](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/work/bat-habitat-yorkshire/): Habitat suitability modelling with Yorkshire bat groups using MaxEnt and existing bat records
- [CV](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/cv/): Professional experience timeline (role, employer, start dates)
- [Notes](https://matthewjwhittle.github.io/notes/): Short notes index (empty until notes are published)
